tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: 77. A bank shall work out the service charges for various types of services like charges for cheque collection etc., with prior approval of its Board or a Committee to which powers have been delegated by the Board12.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: These charges shall be reasonable and not out of line with the average cost of providing these services.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.quote: The bank shall also take care to ensure that customers with low volume of activities are not penalised.
